messages:
marta: Heads up - vuln triage: a dependent lib in our minimal base image is flagged for a high severity syscall infoleak. We should coordinate a rebuild but want to validate KMS/RBAC/audit gating before we start.
ben: can you share the CVE id and which layer?
sasha: CVE_2026_0588, lives in /usr/lib/libdep.so. A rebuild that swaps in patched lib should be straightforward but signing/access is the blocker.
marta: exactly. two asks: 1) ensure the signing key is limited to the ephemeral builder service account; 2) audit logs must capture any cryptokeys.sign calls and include the signer principal.
nora: on (1) we can grant roles/cloudkms.signer only to build/cosign-runner@ namespace and scope the key binding to projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/temp-rebuild/cryptoKeys/canarySign. I suggest a KMS key TTL + rotation within 48h.
xavier: +1, but we need the RBAC change to be auditable in our GitOps PR. Please don't do ad-hoc console grants.
sasha: agreed — will open a small PR with a RoleBinding snippet and link it to CI approval. Proposed RBAC fragment in PR:
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: build-cosign-limited
  namespace: build
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get","create"]
```
and then RoleBinding to cosign-runner SA.
ben: for KMS IAM the least privilege role is roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter? or do we need signer perms? cosign uses asymmetric signing so it needs cryptokeys.sign permission. Create a custom IAM role with only 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign'.
nora: correct. example gcloud (for infra team):
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding canarySign \
  --location global --keyring temp-rebuild \
  --member serviceAccount:build-cosign@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
```
marta: for the audit side, can we assert Cloud Audit Logs include protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail and protoPayload.request.metadata.callerSuppliedUserAgent? We need to parse signature operations in Loki with these fields.
xavier: yes, we ingest admin activity and data access logs into Loki. I'll add a query to surface cryptokeys.sign entries from the past 1h during the rebuild window. Example Loki filter:
```
{job="cloud-audit"} |= "cryptokeys.sign" | json | line_format "${protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail} ${protoPayload.request.resourceName} ${protoPayload.response}"
```
sasha: let's also ensure SLSA attestation includes the commit SHA and the CVE fix line in the predicate so downstream consumers can verify source.
ben: operational play: create canary tag base:2026-03-24-patch1-canary, run unit+smoke in staging, then promote. If audit shows extra principals, revoke key and freeze promotion.
nora: add a registry retention policy: expire canary tags after 14 days. Keep production tags indefinitely.
marta: escalation plan if weird signer activity: 1) pause promotions, 2) rotate key (immediate revoke), 3) run signature verification across recent images and break glass if mismatches, 4) open incident channel and post a short summary.
inxavier: can we add an automated gate in the pipeline to fail if the key used to sign does not match expected key fingerprint? I can add a step that runs `cosign verify --key ksm://... --signature` and compares fingerprint.
sasha: good idea. I'll add a pipeline step and a pipeline-level variable SIGNING_KEY_FINGERPRINT.
secbot: policy-bot: Temporary key lifecycle policy reminder - create keys with explicit expiration and label 'ephemeral:rebuild' per SEC-POL-12.
ben: tiny security nit: limit the builder's network egress to only registry and KMS endpoints during rebuild window. No other external access.
marta: agreed. Network policy will be applied in the PR.
xavier: final checklist before we hit rebuild job: PR merged with RBAC + pipeline guard, KMS IAM binding created via infra IaC change, Loki alert added for cryptokeys.sign anomalies, registry retention set, and smoke tests green.
sasha: I'm targeting the PR by 15:30 PT, infra change by 16:30 PT. I'll post link to PR in this thread.
marta: thanks — ping @sec-oncall if anything pops. We'll run the rebuild at 18:00 PT and monitor the audit stream for 2h.
secbot: scheduler: rebuild-base-job scheduled at 1743220800 -> 18:00 PT.
ben: I'll own monitoring during the window. If we see unexpected principals, I'll revoke and notify.
ora: will prepare a short runbook snippet to attach to PR with commands to inspect KMS policy and audit logs.
xavier: copy. After post-deploy I'll run an attestation audit and close the loop.
sasha: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/rebuilds/pull/799 (WIP)
